module_summary: AXI-stream frame length monitor: accumulates per-beat byte counts (decoded from tkeep) on each accepted transfer and emits the total with a one-cycle valid pulse on tlast.

anchors.name: frame_len_reg
anchors.why: accumulates frame length per transfer; cleared after valid pulse; drives frame_len

anchors.name: frame_len_valid
anchors.why: one-cycle pulse marking frame_len valid at end of frame

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: monitored valid; with tready qualifies counting transfer

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tready
anchors.why: monitored ready; with tvalid qualifies counting transfer

anchors.name: monitor_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: byte-enable mask decoded into bytes-per-beat increment

anchors.name: bit_cnt
anchors.why: number of valid bytes in beat, added to frame length

groups.name: Length accumulator
groups.description: Adds tkeep byte count per accepted beat to frame length

groups.name: Frame end control
groups.description: Detects accepted tlast beat and pulses length valid
